cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 4.3.1.0)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0126 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0128 OLD)
project(CMAKE_TRY_COMPILE CXX)
set(CMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE 1)
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} ${COMPILE_DEFINITIONS}")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG "-g -O0 -fsanitize=address -DDEBUG")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS} ${EXE_LINKER_FLAGS}")
include_directories(${INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES})
set(CMAKE_SUPPRESS_REGENERATION 1)
link_directories(${LINK_DIRECTORIES})
cmake_policy(SET CMP0083 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0155 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0157 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0181 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0210 OLD)
include("${CMAKE_ROOT}/Modules/Internal/HeaderpadWorkaround.cmake")
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "/sessions/optimistic-determined-sagan/mnt/N Averaging/AdS4_Oscillons/build2/CMakeFiles/CMakeScratch/TryCompile-mhhxUo")
add_executable(cmTC_fd8b3)
target_sources(cmTC_fd8b3 PRIVATE
  "/sessions/optimistic-determined-sagan/mnt/N Averaging/AdS4_Oscillons/build2/CMakeFiles/CMakeScratch/TryCompile-mhhxUo/OpenMPTryFlag.cpp"
)
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/cmTC_fd8b3_loc"
     CONTENT $<TARGET_FILE:cmTC_fd8b3>)
set_property(TARGET cmTC_fd8b3 PROPERTY "CXX_STANDARD" "17")
set_property(TARGET cmTC_fd8b3 PROPERTY "CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED" "ON")
target_link_options(cmTC_fd8b3 PRIVATE "-v")
target_link_libraries(cmTC_fd8b3 ${LINK_LIBRARIES})
